english.title: Vehicle - new keeper of unlicensed vehicle fail to inform Secretary of State
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the new keeper of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was unlicensed, failed to deliver the required declaration and particulars in relation to the vehicle to the Secretary of State
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 6 of Schedule 4 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(a) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) No offence is committed where the new keeper takes out a new vehicle licence or nil licence.
(ii) If he is a relevant vehicle trader not later than the end of the period of three month being the day following the day on which the change of keeper occurs or in any other case not later than the day following the day on which the change of keeper occurs.
